scope: Three narrowly scoped public catalogue corrections, applied separately from the code commit. All writes must match the recorded work and edition identity, current year and edition count; all three guards must match. No author, title, edition identity, URL, rating or source identifier is changed.

corrections.title: Sleeping Murder
corrections.reason: Agatha Christie Limited identifies 1976 as publication; disputed wartime writing dates are not publication dates.

corrections.title: Twelfth Night, or What You Will
corrections.reason: Folger states first printing was in the 1623 First Folio. This work-level date also applies to its existing Dutch translation; it does not describe when the translation was printed.

corrections.title: Works [37 plays, 5 poems, sonnets]
corrections.reason: The sole catalogue edition is G. B. Harrison's edited Complete Works. The inherited 1794 generic-work date is not a verified first publication date for this compilation. Catalogue publication dates and seller dates conflict. Remove the unsupported year rather than substitute a guessed edition or printing date. Existing work identifier remains unchanged.
